tracks.title: 國民法官六號 Kok-bîn Huat-kuann La̍k-hō
tracks.subject: an ordinary man drawn by lot as citizen judge number six (Taiwan's citizen judge system) for a six-day fraud trial, who may tell no one, tells his wife it's a business trip, eats cold pork-chop lunchboxes in silence with five strangers, and casts his vote
